title: Q-CFP-worker-logs-on: every Worker keeps its logs on
body:
**Owner:** staff
**Trigger:** CF-POSTURE-1 daily probe, rule `worker-logs-on` failed on the live account
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation cfposture --rule worker-logs-on
**Status:** open

With logs off a failing Worker leaves no evidence, so no loop can find the cause. Measured 2026-11-20: ultrastable-site and tenant-ps-web had logs off although their configs turn them on.

Remedy: deploy the Worker through a path listed in upload_paths (each sends observability), or add observability to its config

Measured:
- good-news
- tenant-ps-edge
- tenant-ps-mail
- ultrastable-did-it-work
- ultrastable-mail-in
- ultrastable-mail-relay
- ultrastable-regulate
- ultrastable-uptime
